summary.name: 迅捷云AI算力超市 (Xunjie AI)
summary.one_liner: A unified AI API gateway that gives one API key access to multiple upstream AI models such as Claude, GPT, and Gemini, with smart routing and failover.
use_cases: Calling several AI models through one API key
Routing API requests across multiple upstream accounts
Paying only for AI usage with quota limits
Avoiding API errors through automatic failover
summary.what_it_does: The page presents an API service that exposes a single endpoint (example shown: POST /v1/messages) for calling connected AI models without separate applications per provider. It says requests are smart-routed across multiple upstream accounts with automatic failover. Billing is described as usage-based with quota limits and team-level consumption visibility. The listed supported models are Claude, GPT, Gemini and Antigravity, with "More" marked as coming soon. The page lists subscription, session persistence and pay-as-you-go options.
notable: Single API key for multiple AI models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Antigravity)
Smart routing across upstream accounts with automatic failover
Usage-based billing with quota limits and team consumption visibility
caveats: Specific prices and plan details are not stated on the page
Model list says more models are coming soon, so coverage is incomplete
